notes: Root cause: observed URL strings (fields.website, fields.socials) interpolated DIRECTLY into href={website} / href={url} with no scheme neutralization. React escapes HTML text but does not block javascript: URLs (warns only). Minimal fix: a single link-resolution seam (parser-based, explicit per-capability scheme allowlist: navigate=http/https only; call=tel:; email=mailto:); renderer interpolates ONLY values the resolver returned as safe. Must keep rejecting: plain/mixed-case/whitespace-prefixed/control-char-smuggled javascript:, data:/vbscript:/file:/blob:, percent-encoded scheme tricks, malformed URLs, non-string input, relative URLs without explicit safe base. Must keep working: https links, tel: dialer links, mailto: links.
